responsibility: purchasing process, contract and supplier risk
situation: Buyer Co. is considering a 3-year subscription to the DocStream AI document-processing platform from Supplier Co. The common deal terms are in deal_terms and Supplier Co.'s current offer is in supplier_offer.
facts: Company rule: for a critical supplier the liability cap must be at least 24 months of fees. Supplier Co. has operated for 9 years and its financial condition is sound.
task: Give your own assessment of this purchase from your function's point of view. You do not decide the purchase; the Purchasing Director does.
reply: Write in English. Answer with one JSON object and nothing else, with exactly these fields: "favor": true if you are in favor of buying on the current offer, false otherwise; "reasons": string; "approval_conditions": string, what would need to be true for you to support the purchase (empty if none); "concerns": string, unresolved concerns (empty if none).
